_comment: Pinned build inputs. Never use 'latest' URLs here — a reproducible build is the whole point, and these hashes are what CI caches on.

ffmpeg._comment: LGPL builds only. We invoke ffmpeg as a separate process so GPL wouldn't infect the app, but distributing a GPL binary still creates source-availability obligations. LGPL + THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt keeps it simple.

aarch64-apple-darwin._source: https://ffmpeg.martin-riedl.de/ — static macOS arm64, pinned build 1785863997_9.0
aarch64-apple-darwin._license: GPLv3 (--enable-gpl --enable-version3), NOT nonfree, so redistributable. See THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md for the source offer. TODO: replace with a minimal --disable-everything LGPL build — it fixes both the licence obligation and ~120 MB of the download size.
aarch64-apple-darwin._rejected: github.com/eugeneware/ffmpeg-static b6.1.1 is --enable-nonfree, which is NOT redistributable at all. fetch_ffmpeg.py checks for this.

x86_64-pc-windows-msvc._source: https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds — win64-lgpl-shared. ffmpeg.exe/ffprobe.exe are ~0.5MB stubs sharing one set of av*.dll, roughly half the size of two static binaries.
x86_64-pc-windows-msvc._license: LGPL (no --enable-gpl). fetch_ffmpeg.py verifies this from the binary's own configure flags at build time.
x86_64-pc-windows-msvc._pinned: Dated autobuild tag, never 'latest' — that tag is rolling and would make builds unreproducible.
